data.one_liner: Create custom neumorphic container widgets, animated containers, and text.
data.what_it_does: Easily create and customize modern neumorphic containers, animated containers, and text widgets for Flutter applications. It supports various shapes, border radii, depth, spread, curves, and a theme system.
use_when: You want to build a user interface with a neumorphic design language
You need containers and text with soft, embossed, or debossed lighting effects
avoid_when: You are using a standard Material or Cupertino design system without neumorphism
You need complex physics or non-neumorphic shape libraries
strengths: Simplifies creating neumorphic widgets like containers and text
Includes animated container support and theme inheritance via ClayTheme
weaknesses: Focused on a single specific visual design trend (neumorphism)
Limited to widgets and animations defined by the package
data.setup_notes: No additional configuration for iOS and Android is needed.
